title: Forming the Celebrity Club band and leaving the Savannah Club
summary: Tate chooses Pat Jenkins, Eli Robinson and Skip Hall and gives up Lucille Dixon's show band.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: About 1950, just -- I had just left Basie. All this is in '50, you know. And I went on down and I went and talked to him. So I started thinking about the cats I wanted and I wanted Pat Jenkins, who had been with Savoy's Sultans -- he was a good section man, you know, he knows how to set them riffs like them Sultans, you know, they were a bitch, you know. So then I had Eli and Eli says, "Well, I can't join you now. But I want to be with the band." He was with Basie's band. I knew he wrote good. And Skip Hall is one of the best small band arrangers I ever met in my life. He makes a band sound like 20 pieces. He was Sy's brother-in-law at that time. Sy Oliver.

Uh-huh. He married Sy's sister. So all those cats was -- they said, "Yeah, man, hell, yeah, we want this gig." So I got them and I worked down Savannah Club like all -- up until Thursdays and on Thursdays, I would leave and come on in and play the Celebrity Club. We, you know, we'd

rehearse and rehearse and rehearse and getting the band in shape and I stayed down there until -- I would send guys down there, man, and I'd send so many guys down there that couldn't read, hell of a players, but when they'd get down there to play them damn shows, they couldn't read. So Lucille says, -- she was so nice -- she says, "Yeah, he could play, but he just couldn't cut the music." So I says, "Lucille, it really isn't fair to you." I stayed down there a long time with her. I says, "I think I'm going to quit altogether and let you get a good saxophone player to learn all the music and do it." I say, "That's right. It's not fair for me to try to hang on and hang you up. I'm trying to get my band together." And I says, "That's enough for me." So I left and finally, she got a good saxophone player that, you know, that was a regular, Taft Jordan and Tyree was in the band, Tyree Glenn. So you know, then, after we got in the Celebrity Club, the band started getting so popular, the clubs would --
